# T-4: Extend the data-directive resolver path to forward directive option objects

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make `{id: "..."}` (and any other future option) reach DataSource methods through `resolveDataDirectives` and `resolver.resolve`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Parsing of an existing 3-part directive with an option object produces params that reach `ds[method]`.
- Existing call sites (agents.js, readme.js, data.js, forge.js) continue to function without behavior change.
- An end-to-end fixture confirms `{id: "foo"}` reaches a DataSource method invocation.

## Implementation Notes
Extend `resolveFn` and `resolver.resolve` signatures; update call sites; existing DataSources whose methods do not consume options ignore the extra argument.

## Test Strategy
Targeted parser/resolver test asserting params plumbing; smoke run of agents.js still passes existing tests.
